mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in cheaper capital costs.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 4.5% over two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 4.5% in two consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is above 4.5% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when both HOUST and RSAFS decline simultaneously in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL above 3.5% year-over-year) triggers restrictive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in prolonged high rates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) consistently compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants anticipate continued accommodative policy.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 for two consecutive months signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 100.0 in two consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS indicate active monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in sustained rate hikes.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS increase simultaneously in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle economic expansions (GDPC1 growth above 2.5% annualized) trigger profit-taking and rising rate expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in economic maturity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is above 2.5% (annualized), or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
